title: Demo call 1: booking a cleaning, then an insurance question

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Thanks for calling Brightside Dental. I'm Callie, the clinic's AI assistant, and this call may be recorded. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning for next Tuesday afternoon, please.

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: One moment. I have Tuesday, October 13th at 2, 30 p.m., 3 p.m. or 3, 3 p.m. Which would you prefer?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Let me check. Yes, Tuesday, October 13th at 3 p.m. is open. Would you like me to book it?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: It's Jane Doe, and my number is 555-123-4567.

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Sure, one second, just to confirm.

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: a cleaning and check-up for Jane Doe on Tuesday, October 13th at 3 p.m. And I'll text the confirmation to the number ending in 4567. Is that right?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: You're all set for Tuesday, October 13 at 3pm. I've sent you a confirmation text. Is there anything else I can help you with?

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Yes, we're in network with Delta Dental. Please bring your insurance card to your first visit. Is there anything else I can help with?

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.text: No, that's all. Thank you. Bye

lines.speaker: Callie
lines.text: Thanks for calling Bright Side Dental. Have a great day. Goodbye.
